posts.title: The Only Way He’d Ever Leave Me
posts.description: "There are three paths forward," the vet explained while Uncle Jesse lay on a stretcher somewhere beyond the double doors of the ER. I wondered if the vet was my age and whether he'd ever had to make this decision himself. He seemed more experienced than the vet I'd seen the night before.

posts.title: The Girlfriend Experience
posts.description: Whoa. He's TALL. And CUTE. When I first saw Randy I was taken aback. After six months of sporadic and not entirely engaging texting, I was ready to be underwhelmed.
